entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to an available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Sarah. How can I help you today?
Hi... yes, I hope you can help. I bought a VeloBand Cadence Sensor a few weeks ago and I... I think I need to return it. I just don't get it.
I'm sorry to hear that it's not working out for you. To understand the situation better, can you tell me what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?

Oh, it's not broken, I don't think. It's just so confusing. I really expected more, you know? The whole interface is just... hard to use. I even read the user manual and I'm still completely lost. Can't you just help me?
Of course, I can certainly look into the return options for you. One moment while I pull up our policy.
Okay, thanks for your patience. I see here that our items are eligible for return within 90 days of delivery. Can I please get your order number?
Oh, 90 days? That's a relief. Yes, the order number is VF-12-98765.
Great, thank you. Let me pull that up... VF-12-98765. I see it was delivered on December 15th. That's well within the 90-day window, so I have gone ahead and approved this return for you.
Wow, that was so much easier than I thought. Thank you so much, Sarah! I really appreciate it.

You're very welcome. I've just sent a pre-paid return label to the email address on file. Just pack the item in its original box, attach the label, and drop it off. Once we receive it, you'll see a full refund within 3-5 business days. Is there anything else I can do for you?
No, that's perfect. That's all I needed. Thank you again!
It was my pleasure. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a wonderful day.
